messages.text: Found the old desktop backup. There is a folder called 'After State U - first offer' with your spreadsheet templates and vendor lists. Want me to save it somewhere easier?
Yes please. Those templates were from the job I picked when everyone said the smaller office would be calmer.
I also see the scanned picture of you in the cap and gown next to abuela and abuelo. Keeping that with the folder?
Keep it. They looked so proud, and then I went straight into purchase orders and month-end totals.
Mija, did you find the county paper with the 10/14 entry? Mine is hiding in the old baptism folder again.
I found mine in the blue envelope. It has San Diego County on the top and Mama's name spelled the old way.
Good. Bring it Sunday if you can. I want to compare it with Papa's 1962 papers before I mail copies to the cousins.
I'll put it with the family photos so I don't forget.
Clouds are light over Tamarack. If you still want the seawall loop, 7:45 would be quiet.
Yes, please. Yesterday left my head crowded, and the water usually sorts me out before errands.
I will bring the slower shoes. Cafe after, or straight home?
Straight home today. I promised Marisol a pot of caldo and I want a few quiet minutes first.
I wrote the appliance repair estimate on the yellow pad from the kitchen drawer. The left side is getting crowded.
Send me a photo when you have a minute. I can look between homework checks.
Photo sent. I already called the shop once, so I only need you to tell me if that warranty line looks strange.
It does look strange. Keep your notes and ask them to explain that part before you sign anything.
Are you coming Friday? The senior center asked for one more helper at the music table, and I promised I would check with you!
Yes, after morning Mass. If they play those old cumbias, I may need to stay near the punch bowl and keep busy.
I saved you a chair for coffee after yoga tomorrow if you feel like coming. No pressure, amiga.
I will keep you on napkin duty. Also, Mr. Ortega asked if you were joining the coffee group after.
Thank you. The house got very quiet after dinner yesterday, so getting out tomorrow would probably be good.
Tell him I already promised that hour to you ladies and the raffle tickets.
I remember. Also, Rosa said the Thursday room is open again this month if you ever want that table.
I kept her card in my purse. I am not going every week, but it helps knowing the door is there.
Sis, do you still have Ma's card with the masa notes? The one where she wrote 'tantito caldo' in the margin.
Yes, tucked inside the church cookbook. I always laugh because the front is all careful school handwriting and the back sounds exactly like Ma in the kitchen.
Send me a picture when you can. I want to make it for Friday, pero no too salty like last time.
I'll send it after walking. And yes, less salt, hermana.
Did you ever write down how Mom toasted the dry peppers before the pot went on? Mine tasted flat yesterday.
Found the little folder from Mexico in the cedar box. Papá's paper stops after '6o' and Mamá's has '4o' then a note from the teacher.
She waited until the skins darkened in little spots, then added onion. I have a few red ones from the back bed drying by the window.
Save those for me. I want copies before the edges fall apart.
Ay, that is the part I forgot. If yours are ready, save me two when I come by after church.
Claro. Same envelope has the photo of him with the mower and the one of her in the white apron by the service elevator.
I will. The cilantro is still small, but there is enough epazote for the beans.
Those two should go with the family photos for the kids, not back in the closet.
Mija, did you still want the link for Thursday's city listening meeting? I saw they have sign-ups for 2-minute comments.
Yes, please. I only wrote down three points: more practice before officers go out alone, someone outside City Hall reading complaints, and a nurse-type team for some 911 calls.
Good. Keep it short or they'll cut you off. Also ask where the numbers are posted, porque siempre esconden todo.
Exactly. I want the monthly totals in plain English, not a PDF maze. Then I'm switching to the senior van and clinic wait-list notes.
I saw the city notice about the car window on Juniper. Are you sending it around, or should I ask the walking group captain?
I will forward the notice after I check it against the city page. I do not want half the block passing around a bad version.
Good idea. Coffee after the walk if people want to talk about it calmly?
Yes, better at the cafe than in a long comment pile. I only put the senior center reminder on my page this morning.
Can you bring the marigold bin when you come by the center tomorrow? The paper banners survived better than I expected!
Yes. I also found Rafael's small frame and the blue candle holders in the garage.
Perfect. And bring your black skirt if you stay for Rosa's footwork hour after setup.
I will. My knees can handle one hour if I wear the low shoes.
For Saturday, do you still want the 8:15 coastal route? It should be dry, but the parking lot will fill early.
Yes, 8:15 is good. I need to be back by 10:30 because Rosa is bringing her tamale costs and the health counter checklist.
That sounds like a lot before lunch. We can keep the walk flat and short.
Thank you. I also told the center I cannot take the sign-in table after that. My afternoon is already marked up.
Would 10:30 work for the coast walk? I know Friday mornings are usually flexible for you.
Yes, 10:30 is fine. I only need to stop by the credit union first to check that the two regular deposits landed.
Good. If the pier lot is full, I will wait by the cafe instead.
Perfect. I am bringing the little notebook too, since March should add up close to 4,800 before the bills come out.
Mom, did the plumber finally send the total? I can swing by after the school board packet is done if you need me to look at it.
He did. It came in lower than the first guess, so I paid it from the little credit union bucket and left the checking alone.
Good. Still okay for the kids' birthday dinner Sunday, or should we do something simpler?
Dinner is fine. I only moved the patio cushions to next month, and I am not touching the IRA for house things.
Did that plumber invoice link open, or is it still doing the spinning wheel of doom?
It opened. I paid it and put Friday's Rubio's idea back on the shelf. I have the Ralphs offers loaded for chicken and rice.
Good. Send me the inn page tomorrow if you want me to check the date-change rules.
I will. Teresa and I were looking at Carmel the last weekend of March, but I want to see the fine print first.
Daniel, can you tell if this CDC page is the current one? The county page links back to it, but the dates confuse me.
Send me the link. If it says updated March 1 at the top, that is the current page.
Found it. I also wrote down what Dr. Nguyen's nurse said, so I just want the timing to match.
That is the right page. Your browser just cached the old county notice, family tech support strikes again.
Daniel, can you send me the county page again? The judge section keeps timing out on my tablet.
Here. Open the PDF, not the flashy page. Page 11 has the endorsements grid and page 19 has the complaint history link.
Gracias. I already marked the national lines earlier. I am slower with the local names because I want to know who has actually done the work.
Very you. I will print the clean table when I come down, but do not let the county website win tonight.
Good morning, Alina. The lagoon path is dry, but the last stretch has uneven boards. Want the shorter loop today?
Shorter loop sounds wise. I wore the newer walking pair with the thicker soles, so I should be all right.
Good morning, Alina. The coastal route is clear at 9:00, but the wind is picking up after 10.
9:00 works. I did my usual half hour before breakfast, so I may take the shorter loop with you.
Still good for the lagoon loop at 9:00? Marine layer looks light, and the path should be easy on knees.
Perfect. We can stop by the rail before coffee if you want to do those slow ankle and balance moves.
Yes. I just need five minutes with the cuff and notebook before I leave.
Shorter loop is sensible. Coffee after, then you can still make your 1:00 kickoff.
Yes, just a few minutes. The class moves always make the walk home smoother.
Perfect. I already set the recording just in case we linger.
No hurry. I packed half a banana and water. Coffee after?
Coffee sounds good. I am bringing black bean soup for Marisol later, so no pastry for me today.
The walking club may end near your street today. Would it be too much to leave my library tote on your porch while we do the lagoon loop?
That is fine. I will unlock the side gate before I leave, and I will be back by 11:30 to bring it inside.
Thank you. Also, the county envelope I mentioned looked like the annual parcel notice. Mine came yesterday.
Mine is on the kitchen table with the servicer statement. I need to compare the escrow line before I mail anything.
Do you want me to pick up the groceries for Sunday, or are you still watching the total after the sink repair?
I can get them. I put the plumber receipt beside the dentist one and moved those two to a separate line.
Good. Keep dinner simple then. I can bring rice and fruit.
That helps. My sheet says a normal month should stay closer to 3,400 to 3,700 if I stop adding surprises.
Coffee after yoga? I can do the little cafe by the center, but only if your mouth is behaving today!
Coffee is fine. The temporary spot is okay, and I am still waiting for the bigger appointment until the March numbers settle.
Bring that folder if you want another set of eyes. Those card statements and pharmacy slips get messy fast.
I put them in the blue pouch with the dentist paper. I only need help making sure I did not count the same charge twice.
I am still on for 7:30. The server patch is running late, so if I call from the car, that is why.
No rush. I will keep the phone nearby after dinner.
Also, I may drive down from the LA side on the 28th if traffic does not look terrible.
That would be nice. Marisol said she can move the Oceanside pickup that day if needed.
Can you check whether this Oaxaca hotel page is real? It says elevator, airport pickup, and a 10-minute walk to the market.
Send the link. Also check the cancellation date before you put money down.
I am only adding it to the little spreadsheet line tonight. The cooking pass page opened too, but I want your eyes on the hotel first.
Looks legitimate. Book directly if you ever do it, not through the ad. The pickup reviews are better than the late bus option.
On our walk, I noticed the patio gate is narrower than it looks. Do you want me to pace it off Saturday before coffee?
Yes, please. The boxes need room for walkers to turn, and I still want space for basil, tomatoes, and a few chiles.
I can bring my tape measure. Your note about watering early before the soil bakes sounded very practiced.
That one is from watching Papi check yards before the sun got strong. He never trusted a pretty plant without checking the dirt.
The library has the Wilkerson book back on the shelf. Want me to grab it before our walk?
Yes, please. The KPBS interview this morning made me want to read slowly instead of just reacting.
I will tuck it in my tote. Also, the League room is smaller than usual Wednesday, so arrive early if you want a chair.
Good note. Since those awful winter hearings years ago, I like hearing the process questions in person when I can.
Can I send you the two-page sheet before I print it? I used your idea about a sentence plus numbers instead of a pet name.
Sure. Also add the part about not reusing the same one everywhere. That always comes up.
Good. I also put screenshots for the little camera button and mute button. Last time everyone kept tapping the red phone by accident.
Send it over. I will mark anything confusing before you run copies.
I found a photo of Mama by the little stove. Back says Logan Ave, but I think that was after the first apartment.
Save it for me, please. I am putting the addresses in order before I write anything down for the kids.
Claro. Also don't make Tío Luis sound foolish about the bus station story. He was just young.
I know. I only want what is true and fair, with the dates clean.
I put your name on the snack list for next Thursday. Just napkins, nothing heavy!
Thank you. I still need to finish the last two chapters before then.
No rush. If it feels like too much, come sit with us anyway. I will meet you by the front desk.
That helps. I will bring the napkins and the questions I wrote on the receipt.
Mom, the council packet is 186 pages. Page 42 is the call chart, page 77 is the outside-review contract. You're welcome, from your unpaid help desk.
Thank you. I need those two pages, plus the school lunch map and the clinic bus route. My printer will complain.
I made you a 9-page PDF. Also page 83 has the training-hours table, but it's tiny.
Tiny is fine. I just want the actual numbers before I write anything.
The website is asking for current employer phone and monthly earnings again. Do I put zero or leave it blank?
When you call Sunday, can you look at the portal with me? It shows the red-white-blue card first, then the other plan card, then the drug list.
Blank if it lets you. If it forces a number, use 0. The regular Treasury and CalPERS entries go in the other section.
Sure. Screenshot the confusing page, not your password. Family tech support has standards.
Good. I also want to see whether the crown office billed the consult or if that waits until they order the new one.
Thank you. Those two together are the 4,800-ish number Marisol wanted for the dental payment plan.
Yep. Screenshot it before you submit, because those portals love pretending they never saw your form.
Send it before the Padres game starts and I will mark which balances are real.
Hermana, did you already ask your doctor about that spring appointment? My portal has three different reminders.
Yes, Dr. Nguyen's nurse said to wait until after the 18th. I printed the county update too, just in case.
Good. Bring the pharmacy paper when you come over and we can compare yours with mine.
I will. Mine says walk-in is fine after 10 AM, but I prefer making the little appointment.
Comadre, did Marisol get stuck with that board agenda again? I can wait until tonight for the pozole notes.
Yes, she has the district meeting and then I am stopping by her place after 5.
Bueno. Call me after you get home if it is not too late. Chula Vista traffic was loud even before lunch today.
I will. I still want to hear what the doctor portal finally showed you.
Comadre, for Friday are you doing pescado again or the chicken in mole?
Pescado on the grill, with calabacitas and salsa fresca. I will make a little mole for the others, but just a spoon for me.
Good. Bring your little notebook too, I want to copy your page layout for my morning numbers.
Claro. Mine has the dates, the two numbers, and a note if I forgot the evening tablet.
For Saturday, do you want the lagoon route or the library loop? Weather says cool and dry.
Library loop, please. I can put the signed county envelope in the outside box after coffee.
Perfect. I will bring the article about the water board candidates too. It is short, but useful.
Good. One of them sounded sensible at the forum, even though she is not on my usual side of the page.
Mom, I can come by Saturday morning for the garage boxes if you still want help. We can stop whenever it feels like too much.
Saturday is fine. I only want to move the camping bin and maybe the blue jacket bag, not everything at once.
Of course. Should I bring the album from our house too, or leave photos alone this weekend?
Leave the album for now. If I am wobbly after, I may use Rosa's number instead of sitting with it by myself.
Mom, the school genealogy packet asks for place, year, and parents' first home here. Should I use the Logan Heights address you showed me?
Yes, use that address. They were there after the move north, before the South Bay apartment.
And for you I have San Diego, 1958, with the October day from the blue envelope. I won't send the photo unless you say yes.
That is fine for the family tree. Keep the picture private, please.
I found the little bakery near Ocean Ave again! Are we still holding that Carmel room?
Let's release the March 27 night for now. Between the sink repair and the dental estimate, I would rather do coffee after yoga here this week.
Of course. I can bring pan dulce, and we will make the coast wait for us.
That sounds better. I also found a Smart & Final special on beans, so I may make a big pot for Sunday.
Are you still looking at the roof papers? I can stop by after yoga if you want another pair of eyes.
I have my yellow page with the two sides filled in. I will make the call myself, but sit with me for ten minutes first?
Of course! Bring the page to the patio and I will bring my reading glasses.
Good. If it still feels too expensive after that, I will ask Marisol to look at the numbers tonight.
Are you coming Tuesday? Carmen said she is doing the chair option again and the long breath count at the end!
I am planning on it. I like when she keeps it slow and lets us use the wall during the standing part.
Good! Wear the black lace-ups, not those pretty flats from Sunday. We can get coffee after.
The flats are staying home. Coffee after sounds nice.
Daniel, the Excel file opened read-only again. I need to add gas, trash, and the dentist payment before I forget.
Close the copy in Downloads and open the one on Desktop. The file name ending in 2026 is the real one.
Found it. The little March tab is unlocked now, and the categories are adding at the bottom.
Perfect. Save it before you start moving anything between rows. Family tech support strikes again.
Mijo, can you remind me how to send the school photos only to the cousins group? I almost put them where everyone can see.
Use the little audience button before you hit Post. If it says Public, back out. Family tech support remains undefeated.
Thank you. Also, someone replied-all to the block note with a whole lecture. I am leaving it alone until I see Mrs. Ito tomorrow.
Solid plan. Screenshots can live forever, Mom.
Mija, did you use Mama's cinnamon for the sweet bread last year or the orange peel one?
Orange peel. I wrote it on the card with her handwriting copied at the bottom.
Good. And don't let Teresa add you to three committees again. You still have the skirt practice on Saturdays.
I promised only the bread table and two practice mornings. After prayers Sunday I am staying home.
Hermana, did the plumber come back, or are you still listening to that drip by the washer?
He finished at 4:15. I stayed in the garage with the checkbook because there was no one else here to hear the doorbell.
Good. Keep that receipt with the tax papers, okay? Repairs always come when the bank papers arrive.
Already clipped together. The balance line is finally small enough that I read it twice.
Walking group is doing the lagoon loop at 9:00. Will you meet us after, or is this one of your quiet Fridays?
For tomorrow's walk, do you still want me to bring the library sleeve for old photos? The coastal air is rough on loose paper.
Yes, please. I have two fragile papers from Mexico and a few work pictures from my parents.
Quiet morning today. I can join coffee at 10:45 if you are still at Vinaka.
Perfect. I will bring that slim book with short family chapters. It may help with the way you are shaping those pages.
I'll bring acid-free sheets. The one you described with the rose clippers and the one with trays would look good side by side.
Thank you. Short is good. I am trying to keep each piece clear enough for the younger ones to read someday.
That is what I was thinking. Marisol wants them labeled before the family dinner.
Mom, do you still need my van Tuesday? I can move the car seats after pickup.
Only if the lumber sample is too long for Teresa's trunk. We are choosing between cedar and recycled plastic for the tall boxes.
Send me the dimensions before I leave work. Also, Daniel found Grandpa Rafael's old level in the garage shelf.
Keep it handy. Papi would tap every corner twice before saying water would sit wrong.
Are you still in for coffee after yoga? I can bring the decoration receipts too!
Yes, coffee works. I put the senior center receipt in my envelope already, separate from the credit union slip.
You and your envelopes. Did Diane approve the boring account choices again?
She said to keep it steady. I added the small March transfer and wrote the $400 line in the margin like she suggested.
Front desk says room 4 is yours Tuesday! They found the projector cart but not the long cord.
Thank you. I will bring my cord and the big-print pages. Do you know if Mr. Salazar is still coming with his new phone?
Yes, and Mrs. Brenner asked if you can show where the doctor messages hide on her clinic page.
I will add a blank example so nobody has to open a real account on the screen.
For Saturday's table, can you greet the older ladies when they come in? They relax when someone says buenos dias first.
Of course. I'll keep the sign-in sheet in plain wording too, so everyone knows where to put their name.
Perfect! Also bring those paper flowers you made. They looked like the ones from your auntie's parties.
I have a bag ready by the door. Mi tia would laugh that I still fold them the same way.
Mom, that website timeout was on their side. Try again tomorrow. Also, did you eat yet?
I ate a little. I put beans on low and walked the lagoon path before it got dark.
Good. Want me to stay on the phone while you finish the forms?
Ten minutes would help. I have mint tea, the stove is off, and I am keeping the evening simple.
The library lecture on Peru is Thursday at 2:00. The flyer says high steps and altitude tips, so I thought of your knee notes.
Thank you. I put it beside the Machu Picchu articles, but only the routes with a slower train and a hotel night before the site.
That sounds sensible. We can walk the flat lagoon path tomorrow and you can tell me what you learned.
Yes, and I will bring the Oaxaca market list too. The food pages are more fun than the stairs.
I returned The Heaven & Earth Grocery Store today. There is still one large-print copy on the hold shelf.
Good timing. Teresa asked if I could bring mine on the 19th because Rosa may need to share.
I can pick it up before our Saturday walk if you want. The library desk opens at 9:30.
Please do. I will give it back after the chairs are put away.
Mom, I scanned the photo from Tia Carmen's reception. Dad is in the corner with his tie loose and one foot already off the chair.
He would say he was just guarding the table from the speakers.
The kids laughed because the next photo has him in the middle of everyone.
Keep that one for Sunday. I will bring the album after church and stay for dinner.
Mateo said his class discussion today used the same clip you asked about, the one comparing 1965 footage with the Capitol doors video.
Tell him thank you. I wrote down the title from the radio, but he explains what his teachers are asking better than the host did.
He says the forum recording is on the school site now. He can show you Sunday after dinner.
Perfect. I want to understand why everyone kept saying the quiet steps matter as much as the speeches.
For the senior center career table, could you bring one old example that shows how you kept everything straight? Your binder tabs would calm people down!
I can bring a blank version of the expense sheet and the vendor contact page. Nothing with names.
Perfect. Also maybe that little story about choosing the heavier desk after finishing school, but keep it short so Maria has time too.
Short is good. I will say I wanted the numbers, calendars, and planning work to be useful, even if it scared me.
Calling at 7 still okay? I want to hear if you survived that ninth inning.
Yes, 7 is fine. I saw it after lunch because I was out by the beach path this morning.
Priorities: sun first, baseball stress second.
Exactly. Tomorrow I will keep it to 35 minutes so my knees do not complain.
Good morning, Mom. We can be there at 1:15. Should I bring tortillas or rice?
Tortillas, please. I already have rice going, and the tomato sauce tastes better with the little peppers from the pots.
The kids will be happy. Mateo asked if you are making the beans with the leaf that smells strong.
Yes, just one sprig. Your grandmother used to say more than that makes the whole house bossy.
I just saw Carmen added you to the Friday setup list too. Did you mean to say yes? The tissue paper boxes are already in my trunk!
No, I will write her. I have Eva at 9:00 for her deposit sheet and then center prep until 3:00. That is enough for Friday.
Good. I can cover the first hour if she needs another pair of hands.
Gracias. I can bring the extension cords Saturday morning, but I am not adding Friday evening.
Mija, did you eat something real tonight? You get quiet on Thursdays.
I made soup and froze two containers. Thursdays still feel strange when the other chair is empty.
Ven conmigo tomorrow after Mass if you want. Or call that woman from the little room, the one with the tea.
I might call if the night stretches. Last time I left lighter, even though I almost skipped it.
Are you coming to the library room after yoga? They moved our discussion to 11:30. Same room with the mural.
Yes. I brought the little paper from the candles night. I still have questions about who answers nonviolent calls and who checks the complaint files.
Good. I'll bring the folder from the senior table too. Maria said the school board flyer and the citizenship clinic flyer can sit together.
Perfect. One stack for families, one for older neighbors, and one for the city questions.
The insurance website has three plan boxes and my yellow pad is too messy now. Can I send you the screenshots?
Yep. Send screenshots. I will translate the website nonsense, family tech support reporting for duty.
Thank you. I already wrote the questions for the agent, so just tell me which box matches the dental line.
Middle one. Keep your questions handy and do not click enroll until they answer the deductible part.
I cleaned up the scan names. Yours is now alina_sd_1958_10-14.pdf. The old Papa folder has the 1961 and 1964 cards together.
Thank you. Please keep Mama's papers with Papa's, not mixed with mine.
Done. I also added the San Ysidro folder label so Marisol can find it without calling tech support.
Comadre, do you still want my pozole verde recipe for Sunday?
Yes, please. I have the Northgate card price for tomatillos and hominy saved, so Sunday can stay at my table.
Bueno. I will send it after Mass. Did you and Teresa pick a new weekend for the coast?
Mija, do you still have the picture where Papa is holding your campus flowers? I want it for the family board.
I found it with the old offer letters. Mama wrote on the back that nobody in the house knew how the ceremony line worked.
Ay, I remember. Then you picked the office that stayed late with invoices and reports. Stubborn, like always.
Not yet. I moved that folder under May and kept this month simpler.
Stubborn maybe. But those classes finally made sense when I was building budgets and keeping the calendar from falling apart.
I found a clean transfer of that Los Panchos album you asked about. Want me to put it on the tablet when I drive down next weekend?
Yes, thank you. I tried one song while making the chile verde and had to lower the burner before I forgot the onions.
I'll make a folder and label it so you don't have to hunt through the app.
Good. After Mass and lunch with Marisol, you can show me. No rushing; Sunday evening is already for your call anyway.
Can you put Mateo's recital picture in the family chat, not on your main page? His teacher asked families to be careful with faces.
Of course. I sent it to the WhatsApp group with the cousins and your brother, and I skipped the tags.
Thank you. Also did you see the notice about the porch package on Alder? Our office got the same warning.
Yes. I passed along the official note only. If people start blaming each other, I am not adding anything there.
Mom, Sofia has to bring one family saying for her class display. She wants the one you always say before serving caldo.
Tell her: 'Con paciencia sale mejor.' Then she can write underneath, 'With patience it comes out better.'
That's perfect. She said your house always has better sayings than the internet.
The internet did not stand next to my mother stirring a pot for an hour.
The kids can come by at 5:30 if that is still okay. I can bring sparkling water and tortillas.
Perfect. I am making rice now, then taking the long way by the water before they arrive.
Do you want me to pick up anything else?
Just limes. After my walk I will light the candle for your dad and call Teresa back.
I printed the kids' photos for your October box. Do you want copies of Dad's Navy picture too?
Yes, one small copy. I will put it with the candles and the mole recipe card.
Also, Sofia says your skirt turns looked pretty in Teresa's video. She wants to see the ribbon part next time.
Tell her I am still learning that part. She can help me sort flowers after Sunday lunch.
Mom, for the family-history table Sunday, should I write the captions in English and Spanish?
Both. For Grandpa's, mention the yards and fixing things. For Grandma's, mention the hotel rooms and later the lunch trays.
Got it. Do you want the Mexico slips under each photo or kept in the folder?
Under the photos, but just first names and the town. The small numbers on the slips can speak for themselves.
The marine layer is thick. Would 8:20 be better for the walk than 8:00?
8:20 works. I need ten minutes first to cover the tomato starts and move the chile tray out of the damp.
That sounds wise. I can bring the library bags after coffee if you still want them.
Thank you. I promised Marisol a small container of salsa later, so I will pick cilantro before we leave.
Rosa found three choices for April. I liked the short one best, but I promised not to campaign too loudly!
Send me the titles when you have them. I will vote after I check what the library has.
Also, coffee after the next Thursday one? You left quickly last time.
Yes, coffee sounds good. I was glad you waved me over when I got quiet.
I can come by after the Oceanside campus walkthrough, probably 5:40. Do you still want me to bring the copies?
Yes, please. I will have the rice ready and save some for Daniel if he makes the Saturday drive.
Good. Elena sent me the cinnamon correction too, so I will print that page with the others.
Perfect. I talked with her this morning and forgot to write it down.
Mom, are you still okay for school pickup tomorrow, or should I ask Luis? I remember you had the CVS thing this week.
I am fine for pickup. CVS was quick, and the pharmacist's sheet matched what Dr. Nguyen's office told me.
Perfect. Please put the paper with your health folder so Daniel does not have to hunt for it later.
Already done. I also saved the county link in my notes, next to the CDC page Daniel checked.
Sofia asked again where Abuela learned English. She is doing that school ancestry chart and wants the real version, not the quick dinner version.
Tell her I am working on a few pages she can read when they are tidy. I still need Elena to confirm one address.
She will love that. And thank you for making it careful; the kids listen differently when you have the papers and dates ready.
That is why I am taking my time. No guessing, no making anyone smaller, and everything back in its folder afterward.
Hermana, did your March money come in right? Mine posted a day late and scared me.
Mine is there now. The two usual lines came to just under 4,800 after the small adjustment.
Bueno. I am still fighting that form asking who signs my checks.
I wrote none for that part and attached the bank page instead. No one is sending me a company check either.
Mana, for Saturday in Balboa Park, are you wearing the shoes with the inserts? Lots of standing near the garden.
Yes, those and the little stretch band in my purse. I used it after class yesterday and it helped before the stairs.
Bueno. We can sit before lunch too. No need to act like we are twenty.
Agreed. I will plan the route with benches.
Hermana, I used your little card trick and finally got into the lab results page. No yelling at the screen today.
Good. Keep that card in the kitchen drawer, not in your purse. And remember the new phrase has to be different from the bank one.

events.notes: Cuff numbers before breakfast. Tuesday pillbox. Soak pinto beans; chop zucchini, tomato, onion for soup.

events.title: Pacific View Servicing autopay check
events.notes: Confirm March draft posted; move $150 to extra principal if checking balance still above cushion. File statement in blue house folder.

events.title: Enter Feb numbers in Excel
events.notes: Use receipt folder: dentist, plumber, SDG&E, water, groceries. Flag Feb total near 4,200 before moving March rows.

events.title: Check March deposits and bills
events.notes: Match Treasury 310 and CalPERS lines before paying utilities; March total should be about $4,800. Leave the blank earnings box alone on the clinic form.

events.title: Copy 18 handouts before 10:00 group
events.notes: One page each: inbox buttons, making a new passphrase, and joining the practice call. Bring blue markers and the sample tablet.

events.title: March health envelope
events.notes: Enter auto-drafts for two cards, pharmacy receipts, dentist estimate, and $42 office visit balance before grocery list.

events.title: Mat class - community center
events.notes: Bring strap, water, and the gray lace-up walkers. Stay near wall for balance section.

events.title: March worksheet: Oaxaca cooking week / Peru folder
events.notes: Move $75 into the separate column. Compare daylight-arrival flights, elevator hotels, and guided options before saving any festival pass links.

events.title: Luz - menu numbers and city form
events.location: Carlsbad Senior Center, small meeting room
events.notes: Bring calculator, last year's spreadsheet, and county checklist. Leave by 11:00 for papel flowers table setup.

events.title: Diane call - IRA mix + March cushion
events.notes: Ask about leaving the 60/40 setup alone. Check credit union side account after plumber bill; keep the line above $400.

events.title: Marisol - soup pot and homework papers
events.notes: Bring cilantro and the blue folder. Ask about Friday campus packet before calling Elena after 8.

events.title: County packet at kitchen table
events.notes: Compare sample guide, council bios, school board notes, and measure summaries. Leave blue envelope by fruit bowl; check signature before bed.

events.title: Lagoon loop before errands
events.notes: Supportive shoes; be home before the 12:40 first pitch.

events.title: Call Dr. Nguyen office about March dose timing
events.notes: Ask whether to do the pharmacy slot before Sunday dinner. Check county notice again before calling.

events.title: Vons pickup + call Sea View Inn
events.notes: Load app offers before checkout. Get soup vegetables, tortillas, eggs. Ask about moving the March 27-28 Carmel-by-the-Sea hold.

events.title: Courtyard planter layout notes
events.notes: Measure west fence line; compare 30-inch and 36-inch cedar boxes; check water reach. Bring Papi's old spacing card for tomatoes and chiles.

events.title: Library holds, KPBS hour, civic forum
events.location: Georgina Cole Library, Carlsbad; online at home
events.notes: Pick up two reserved titles before closing. Listen to KPBS segment at 5:30. Join 6:30 forum on court decisions, ballot counting, and public trust; ask Marisol for the student panel link.

events.title: Chapters 6-10 group
events.notes: Bring library copy and the page with the blue sticky note. Teresa said she can save the aisle chair.

events.title: Room 3B drop-in, if needed
events.location: Carlsbad Community Center, 799 Pine Ave, Room 3B
events.notes: Bring small notebook. Rosa usually sets the circle by the windows. Decide after dinner.

events.title: Kitchen table pages
events.notes: Phone off. Sort Mama's envelope, old church address, 1974 lease copy. Leave room to check dates with Elena.

events.title: Center prep: frames, flowers, bread order forms
events.location: Carlsbad Senior Center, craft room B
events.notes: Bring glue dots, tissue flowers, Rafael photo copy, recipe cards, black practice shoes. Rosa uses room after 11:30.

events.title: Sort blue envelope + old papers
events.notes: Pull San Diego County certificate copy, 1958 hospital card, Mama/Papa border cards, and 1960s South Bay lease before Elena visits.

events.title: Candle table at Pine Ave steps
events.location: Pine Ave Civic Plaza, Carlsbad, CA
events.notes: Bring battery candles, water bottle, and blue sweater. Stay near Teresa. Afterward, save the handout with the names and the city hotline chart.

events.title: Water back beds; clip green things for noon pot
events.notes: Check tomato stakes, pinch cilantro tops, bring in 3 jalapenos if firm. Start beans after Mass.

events.title: Mass, Marisol lunch, photo envelope
events.location: St. Patrick Catholic Church; Marisol's house, Oceanside
events.notes: Bring arroz, Rafael's brown envelope of reception photos, and the small box of old records if Marisol still wants them for the family table.

events.title: Kitchen table notes before calling contractor back
events.notes: Yellow pad in drawer. Left/right columns for roof quote. Call Teresa after coffee if the deposit line still bothers me; keep Daniel as spare-key contact only if workers need access.

events.title: Sort family photos for altar table
events.notes: Bring Abuelita Lupe photo, marigold tissue paper, papel picado patterns, and the little notebook with Ma's sayings.

events.title: Ponto Beach path, then chicken tinga prep
events.notes: Bring rosary, water bottle, and market list. Call Elena before dinner if the house feels too quiet.

events.title: Sort garage box: campus papers + first office binders
events.notes: Keep framed stage photo, tuition receipts, offer letters, old budget binder tabs, mileage log sheets, vendor card file, and weekly schedule notebooks. Shred duplicate reports.

events.title: Scan family papers for Marisol
events.notes: Bring cedar-box folder: Mexico report slips, Papá photo with pruning shears, Mamá apron photo, hotel badge, lunch-line photo.

events.title: Check block digest and forward verified items
events.notes: Compare with city alert page before sending. Put family photos in private album only. Save any touchy replies for Tuesday coffee.

events.title: Marta booth math before heritage night
events.notes: Review $3.75 unit cost, $6/$7 options, and temporary seller form. March center hours penciled so far: 9.5.

events.title: Daniel phone
events.notes: Ask about password screen and whether the 3/28 drive from the LA side still works. Text Elena tomorrow with recipe changes.

events.title: Community center mat class
events.notes: Use folded blanket under joints; skip deep bends. Wear blue walking shoes for errands after.

events.title: Room 4 group: inbox + clinic-page demo
events.notes: Bring sample Gmail account, paper passphrase cards, HDMI cord, and fake MyChart printout. Leave 10 minutes for one-on-one questions.

events.title: Registrar box before yoga
events.notes: Bring sealed county envelope from kitchen counter. Double-check water district choice and council seat notes before leaving.

events.title: Walgreens pickup + market stop
events.location: Walgreens Carlsbad Blvd; State Street Farmers Market
events.notes: $11 refill. Buy white beans, cilantro, tomatoes, cabbage, and two pieces of cod.

events.title: Dental office payment call
events.notes: Give household monthly figure as 4,800. Use bank notes from Treasury 310 and CalPERS; no separate company check to include.

events.title: Call Harbor Dental billing
events.notes: Ask whether crown replacement can be scheduled after April 10 deposit. Confirm patient share after both cards are run.

events.title: Senior center current-events circle
events.notes: Bring notes from KPBS call-in show and the two library chapters. Topic card: counting rules, peaceful handoffs, and who gets heard at city meetings.

events.title: CVS appointment - bring ID and Medicare card
events.notes: Booked after Dr. Nguyen message. Ask pharmacist for printed after-care sheet and confirm next recommended window.

events.title: Room 3 pages: finish novel
events.notes: Take Linda's large-print copy, napkins, and the folded question sheet. Teresa will text if the room changes.

events.title: Review planter sketch with Teresa
events.notes: Finalize count: 6 long boxes, 2 shorter herb boxes. Add stool-height ledge option. Ask about drip line timer. Bring Papi's pencil sketch of the three-zone watering pattern.

events.title: Friday pages + document box
events.notes: Draft two pages from Papa's bus ticket copy and Mama's first payroll stub. Mark uncertain dates in pencil. Put originals back in blue folder.

events.title: Credit union transfer
events.notes: $50 from checking to side account after pension deposit clears. Do not change Vanguard auto-withdrawal.

events.title: Pay March home items
events.notes: SDG&E due 3/22, water due 3/24, HOA autopay check, internet confirmation. Update Excel after confirmations clear.

events.title: Call Pacific View about payoff letter
events.notes: Ask why April amount changed after escrow review. Keep call notes in blue house folder before Marisol comes Sunday.

events.title: Senior center group - harbor route
events.notes: Bring water, knee sleeve, library book for Linda. Back by 12:30 for Wave kickoff.

events.title: Compare Oaxaca dates + Cusco sample costs
events.notes: Update separate column after groceries. Keep only refundable fare examples, central lodging with elevator, licensed day guide, and no red-eye arrival.

events.title: Update March plans
events.notes: Move Carmel-by-the-Sea folder to May. Check Albertsons app before Thursday pickup. Use leftover chicken for Teresa lunch instead of Harbor Fish Cafe.

events.title: League candidate forum notes
events.notes: Ask only one question if time is tight: posted complaint totals or clinician van schedule. Pick up flyers on Medicare counseling, classroom aides, tenant help, and language access forms.

events.title: Early dinner, then decide
events.notes: Set one place. If the house feels too still, call Rosa before 6:30 or drive to Pine Ave.

events.title: Read picture book for grandkids' class visit
events.notes: Bring tamalitos storybook, family recipe card copy, and two bookmark stacks: classroom version plus abuelitos table version.

events.title: Call county records office
events.notes: Ask about extra certified copy for October 14 record; confirm San Diego County archive can match 1958 certificate with parents' names as listed.

events.title: Prep notes for Teresa's career table
events.notes: Bring blank Excel printout, sample schedule grid, redacted vendor index card, and the framed campus photo. Mention choosing the busy first offer because the coursework felt too hard-earned to put away.

events.title: Rosa session + center table list
events.location: St. Michael parish hall, side room
events.notes: Wear red sash, bring low shoes. Afterward: confirm candle count, photo stands, tamale sign-up sheet, and children's paper-flower station.

events.title: Prep for family table
events.notes: Roast tomatoes and 2 jalapenos. Cut cilantro last. Check if epazote by fence has enough leaves for the pot.
